status_ladder.ABSENT: a stated code search found no mechanism; named only by the directive
status_ladder.INVENTORIED: named in a repository registry, reserved-family record or backcast; nothing executes it
status_ladder.INTEGRATED: reachable through GREG's one cognition path (cognition.reason / the Competency Compiler)
status_ladder.BENCHMARKED: a frozen evaluation exists (any verdict, including SUPERSEDED, REJECTED, COMPOSITION_ONLY, EXPERIMENTAL)
status_ladder.ADMITTED: DEFAULT_FOR_GEOMETRY or NICHE_CAPABILITY under the admission rule at its current version
status_ladder.ATTACHED: founder-attached (none: seed families and cortex organs are attached at registration by code, which is recorded separately)
status_ladder.EXERCISED: used inside a GREG mission run on the durable mission path with a recorded receipt

status_rules: An item's status is the highest status of its direct mechanisms; precursors are listed and never raise it.
Rungs are not cumulative: an EXERCISED organ need not be ADMITTED (none is); a BENCHMARKED genome may have been refuted.
Lineage 'both' means the cited code or evidence exists at the merge base of #158's line and #179; '#158' only on this line; '#179' only on PR #179.
Evidence written git:<sha>:<path>:<line> lives on PR #179's branch and is not in this tree.

section_31.condition: The five layers are represented by real executable mechanisms, not merely documents.
section_31.attained: Every layer has executable mechanisms: L1 6 genomes + micro; L2 6 genomes (+ crowd, swarm on #179); L3 33 genomes plus the catalog operation families (21 catalog families across layers) and 8 cortex organs; L4 develop_repair, develop_constraint_release, P8, Genesis; L5 the compiler.
section_31.remaining_gap: Directive-named families with no executor: associative microcircuits/networks, small local learners, rate control, beam/MCTS/iterative deepening, GA/QD/novelty/hyperheuristics, MDL, repeated games/bargaining/commitment, theorem proving, robust control, centrality, community/topology analysis, convex optimization, judgmental and scenario forecasting, global workspace, active inference, ecology bidding, differentiation, cellular automata, graph diffusion.

section_31.condition: The major present-day mathematical/computational intelligence families are registered and benchmarked.
section_31.attained: 47 genomes benchmarked under the admission rule (35 admitted); cortex Fermi/Z3/CP-SAT benchmarked in cross-geometry v0.3; #179 benchmarked 16 operation families.
section_31.remaining_gap: Unbenchmarked major families: semantic (no model, NOT_RUN), SAT, convex/nonlinear optimization, packing, centrality, community analysis, beam/MCTS, GA/QD/novelty, MDL, repeated games/bargaining, theorem proving, robust control, judgmental/scenario forecasting, probabilistic programming, digital twins. Most Layer 1, 2 and 4 admissions are on simulated worlds.

section_31.condition: Problem geometry selects methods based on actual competence.
section_31.attained: The compiler ranks candidates by frozen admission status, subregion evidence and settled outcomes; tests check it routes exactly on fresh positive evidence.
section_31.remaining_gap: No genome is attached, so on a real body the compiler issues attach asks and routes to fallbacks; no competence has been settled from real founder missions; within a family, geometry routing added nothing in any P6 run (the router chose the static recipe).

section_31.condition: Multiple intelligences can compose through typed evidence and receipts.
section_31.attained: Typed translation between stage receipts; compilation receipts carry intermediate receipts; schedule extraction -> CP-SAT ran on the supervised body.
section_31.remaining_gap: Composition has been exercised on a body only for the cortex extraction -> CP-SAT pipeline, with a test key.

section_31.condition: Composition produces repeated VPL across materially different held-out problem families.
section_31.attained: Six recipes show VPL_LIFT on held-out families (F1, F2R, F4, F6, F7, F8); natural families lift 3 of 4 (F6, F7, F8).
section_31.remaining_gap: Lift is composition over GREG's own repertoire: F7 is NO_LIFT once flow_expansion_mcf is a constituent and ties the OR practitioner; F8's EWMA ablation is cheaper; F6 loses to the weekly-mean practitioner on day count; routing adds nothing within a family; every lift costs 1.5-5.2x latency; F8 data rights unverified. No family drawn from GREG's own operating needs.

section_31.condition: Conditional competence can either demonstrate useful lift or be truthfully demoted if the static policy wins.
section_31.attained: Decisive pre-registered P4 retest: REGRESSION (160 vs 162); conditional routing demoted, static default kept.
section_31.remaining_gap: None for the condition; conditional competence may be retested only with a new pre-registration.

section_31.condition: Protected evolution can improve nonconstitutional cognition against an evaluator it cannot alter.
section_31.attained: Cycle 6 RETAIN under a sealed, clean-room evaluator: held-out 105-73, p = 0.00995, mean loss 29.6% lower; canary passes.
section_31.remaining_gap: One kept improvement in seven designs; it misses the programme-wide threshold 0.00833; random restart is at least as good (80-89); the proposal is not applied (founder adoption); no second target (cycle 7 NOT_VIABLE); the stress-gate repair's historical-equivalence claim is unverified (its test exercises the fallback path).

section_31.condition: Collective/swarm mechanisms demonstrate native competence on appropriate geometries.
section_31.attained: ACO DEFAULT and Physarum NICHE on mathematical instances; market DEFAULT, quorum and immune NICHE on simulated worlds.
section_31.remaining_gap: Flock SUPERSEDED; PSO and Dawid-Skene beat only weak baselines (#179); no collective mechanism admitted on natural data; immune tolerance, ecology bidding and PSO (on #158) have no executor.

section_31.condition: Developmental/morphogenetic mechanisms remain safely separated from biological claims and demonstrate at least bounded structural adaptation in simulation.
section_31.attained: develop_repair NICHE (simulated lattice) and develop_constraint_release DEFAULT (mathematical instances); worlds.py and the frontier backcasts keep biological claims out.
section_31.remaining_gap: Generalized repair did not replicate (12-3, then 7-8); MICA ties a central replanner (#179); no capability-topology assembly.

section_31.condition: Human/expert intelligence is a legitimate typed route where machine methods are insufficient.
section_31.attained: Typed human route with role, competence domain, conflicts, refusal and question-bound founder decision.
section_31.remaining_gap: No real qualified-human judgment has been recorded; only the founder role can decide.

section_31.attained: Every receipt carries authority_created false and EXISTING_KERNEL_GATE_REQUIRED; P8 decisions PROPOSED_NOT_APPLIED.
section_31.remaining_gap: A universal negative is tested, not proven; it holds for the paths the tests cover.

section_31.condition: Receipts preserve how conclusions were obtained.
section_31.remaining_gap: Proof artifacts are typed, but later_appraisal and outcome_link are filled only after settlement, which has no real founder outcomes.

section_31.attained: SUPERSEDED/REJECTED/COMPOSITION_ONLY genomes are excluded; NO_LIFT recipes ranked last; P4 demoted; settled outcomes inhibit after 10.
section_31.remaining_gap: On-body inhibition has never fired on real outcomes.

section_31.condition: Missing competence can trigger Capability Genesis.
section_31.attained: A compiler CAPABILITY_DEFICIT enters Genesis: withheld genome, then an installed package qualified on a frozen oracle, then the founder; the original mission closes after attach.
section_31.remaining_gap: Exercised only on test-key tmp bodies; the recorded live Genesis run (2026-09-26) built a non-cognition function.

section_31.condition: The Mind remains one component of the complete Body + Organs + Mind GREG.
section_31.attained: One cognition entry on the capability/mission path; no second registry, router, ledger or authority.
section_31.remaining_gap: VEPMC = 0 (mac_body missing); organs (DALEOBANKS, WMI) do not consume cognition receipts; Goal Gravity never ran on a real founder goal.

section_31.condition: All speculative descendants remain preserved in the Backcast GPS horizon.
section_31.attained: 13 frontier backcasts, each with nearest falsifiable experiment and buildability.
section_31.remaining_gap: None missing; precursors for most are untested.

section_31.condition: The project can state exactly what is built, simulated, experimentally supported, externally verified, unresolved, or frontier.

prioritized_build_list.scope: Independently re-derive every recorded P8 adversarial-gate decision (cycles 1-6) under the old worsened() and the new stress_worsened(). The cycle records keep only per-set means (e.g. cycle-cr-6.json adversarial: {lean, fewval}: incumbent/candidate means), so the audit must regenerate item-level stress outputs from each cycle's seeded stress sets, frozen configuration and source commit in a clean checkout (stress sets are not held-out data). Finite recorded means imply zero wrong answers in both arms, so the only route to a changed decision is the new both-answered restriction when abstentions occurred; report that case explicitly. Cover paired alignment, equal/fewer errors, empty sets, NaN/inf/malformed values, and the documented rule text. Where regeneration is impossible, record UNRESOLVED, never equivalent.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: For each cycle, a row {cycle, regenerated: bool, old_decision, new_decision, wrong_counts, both_answered_n}; the test fails if any row claims equivalence without item-level outputs, and passes hostile cases (3 vs 2 wrong; equal wrong with worse answered mean; empty set; NaN).
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: Any recorded cycle decision differs under the new function, or a cycle cannot be regenerated (then the 'no recorded decision changes' claim in b7b1ed9 is unsupported for it).
prioritized_build_list.natural_or_synthetic: re-derivation of recorded synthetic stress sets

prioritized_build_list.scope: One machine-readable ledger of every seed range, data file (sha256), split, pilot, admission, P6 family, P8 cycle and test fixture across #158's tree and PR #179 (read through git show), with the generator code digest that produced each item and whether its outcomes were looked at. Flags: overlapping seeds, the same data file under different seeds (the forecast_quantile/P8 M4 erratum pattern), and the same generator with different seeds (not independent by seed number alone). Read-only; changes no split.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Every freeze.json, PREREGISTRATION.md seed declaration, pilot record and admission run in both lineages is parsed (count reported and checked against a glob); #179's seeds 1001-1040, 2001-2040, 3001-3040, 5001-5040 and #158's 1000-1329, 7000-9199 appear; the successor pilot's review seeds are shown unused.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: A seed or data item later found used by a committed artifact but missing from the ledger; or two evaluations sharing a data file digest reported as independent.

prioritized_build_list.scope: New target identity (e.g. immune_detect_narrow) with explicit lineage to the cycle-7 NOT_VIABLE pilot; the narrowed space is justified causally (the frozen search chose high alarm_fraction configurations that win paired items but add 4-6 false-alarm violations per 540) and its bounds are declared before any new outcome; fresh unused review seeds from the exposure ledger; arms: incumbent, random restart, the strongest simple baseline, and fixed configurations informed by cycle 2's record (labelled as informed); predeclared resource limits, stopping, viability rule, selection rule and multiple-attempt accounting. Shared RULE unchanged. If VIABLE, freeze the trusted implementation and run the confirmatory cycle once; otherwise preserve NOT_VIABLE.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Pilot rules committed before any pilot instance exists (commit order checked by test); verdict computed by the declared rule; reserved cycle-7 seeds untouched.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: Pilot NOT_VIABLE (best mean simulated P(RETAIN) below the declared threshold), or a confirmatory REJECT; either is recorded as the result.
prioritized_build_list.effort: M-L (2-3 days; depends on B01 and B02)

prioritized_build_list.scope: A consequence-inert cognition family drawn from GREG's own operating need: check every numeric claim in evidence READMEs (W-L counts, p-values, percentages, statuses) against the results file it cites, and flag mismatches. Native competitor arms: no-check baseline, regex-extraction-plus-exact-recomputation genome, and (when a local model exists) the semantic organ; composition semantic extract -> exact recompute is the P6 candidate.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Pre-registered admission on held-out READMEs (split by directory, decided before reading); recall on the natural positives (claims later corrected by the 26 READMEs that carry errata quoting the original wording) and false-flag rate on claims the recomputation confirms.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: The genome misses errata-recorded misstatements at a rate not better than the baseline, or false-flags exceed the declared ceiling.
prioritized_build_list.natural_or_synthetic: NATURAL: the README claim population of both lineages and the errata as labelled positives; truth by exact recomputation from the cited JSON. Any injected corruptions are SYNTHETIC and reported separately.

prioritized_build_list.scope: Natural-input problem family: the Python import graph of this repository at K historical commits (git show, no network). Questions: minimum vertex/edge cut between the mission engine and each organ adapter or evidence writer (single points of failure), and the longest dependency chain. Arms: flow_maxflow and critical_path genomes, degree-centrality heuristic baseline, exact networkx truth; P6 candidate: bottleneck detection -> min_cost_flow allocation of a hardening budget.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Instances built only from commits declared before the run; truth independently computed; VPL accounting (false answers, latency, cost) against the strongest single genome.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: Composition ties or loses to flow_maxflow alone (the F7 pattern), or the degree heuristic matches the exact cut on most instances.
prioritized_build_list.natural_or_synthetic: NATURAL inputs (GREG's own repository history), MATHEMATICAL truth computed from each instance; the hardening-budget values are SYNTHETIC unless taken from recorded incident counts.

prioritized_build_list.scope: Extend scripts/mind_status.py with an EXERCISED projection read from retained mission ledgers (cognition receipts with method, version, mission id, key provenance) and lineage-tagged rows for #179's operation-family admissions read from a pinned commit, without merging code or changing routing. Today only the cortex rehearsal (test key) exercises cognition.cortex, extraction.schedule and optimization.cpsat.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: mind_status reports the three exercised organs with the rehearsal ledger as evidence and marks the key as non-founder; #179 rows appear with source commit 0067be6 and never alter the compiler's routing (existing compiler-consistency test still passes).
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: A mission receipt the ledger scan misses (checked against a grep of retained ledgers), or #179 rows changing a routed status.

prioritized_build_list.scope: The acquisition target #179's sparse-crowd test named: the one-step agreement-weighted (Nitzan-Paroush) vote as a Layer-2 genome; admit against majority vote and Dawid-Skene on fresh seeds on both dense and sparse crowds.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Pre-registered admission on unused seeds from the exposure ledger; v1 status rule unchanged.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: It does not beat majority vote on the sparse geometry, or it ties Dawid-Skene on dense crowds and loses on neither (then COMPOSITION_ONLY/EXPERIMENTAL).
prioritized_build_list.natural_or_synthetic: SYNTHETIC (simulated crowds); the oracle gap 0.197 vs 0.338 states the headroom

prioritized_build_list.scope: Commodity SciPy multistart L-BFGS-B as the nonlinear/smooth black-box genome (#179 measured it beating PSO 32-7 post hoc and DE 26-8); pre-registered admission against PSO and DE, plus a noisy/discontinuous objective menu where gradient-free methods may regain ground.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Admission on fresh seeds with the evaluation budget equalised in function evaluations.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: It loses to PSO or DE on the declared noisy/discontinuous menu (then NICHE for smooth objectives only).

prioritized_build_list.scope: Measure whether each of the 15 typed operators changes a compiled answer, method choice or requirement on a frozen set of compiler requests (existing test geometries plus the P6 families), against the compiler with that operator removed; operators that never alter an answer are recorded as such (the directive: recruit them when the geometry indicates they can alter the answer).
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Per operator: count of requests where its removal changes selected method, requirements or result; frozen before running.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: An operator with zero effect on every request in its declared signature, which then becomes a rule annotation rather than an operator.
prioritized_build_list.natural_or_synthetic: mixed: P6 natural families (F6-F8 inputs) and synthetic compiler requests, labelled per request

prioritized_build_list.scope: The next Layer-4 test both lineages name: damage arriving during transport and loss of the central coordinator, against a central replanner that replans every k ticks; develop_repair and MICA arms on the same seeds; pre-registered, simulated world.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Pre-registered sign test on delivered throughput across unseen dynamic-damage seeds; ties reported as PARITY.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: PARITY or loss against the periodic replanner (then the distributed mechanism has no measured advantage beyond coordinator independence).

prioritized_build_list.scope: Record per-test durations once from a local single-core run of this repository's suite (consequence-inert), then build makespan instances (k CI workers) from them; arms: CP-SAT (the exercised organ), LPT greedy practitioner, knapsack/BnB-based bin assignment; truth: proven CP-SAT optimum. Relevant to the real CI limit raised to 45 minutes.
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Pre-registered: instances drawn from recorded durations with k declared; certificate of optimality per item.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: LPT within 1% of optimal on nearly every instance (no lift worth the latency).
prioritized_build_list.effort: M (1 day plus one full-suite recording run, which exceeds light compute and must be scheduled)
prioritized_build_list.natural_or_synthetic: NATURAL inputs (GREG's own test durations), MATHEMATICAL truth

prioritized_build_list.scope: NetworkX betweenness/approximate centrality and modularity community detection as genomes, admitted only where decision-relevant: on SNDlib topologies and B05's import graphs, does centrality predict the exact min-cut control points better than degree?
prioritized_build_list.acceptance_test: Pre-registered admission against degree and against the exact cut.
prioritized_build_list.falsifier: Centrality never beats degree at identifying exact cut vertices (then REJECTED: not decision-relevant).
prioritized_build_list.natural_or_synthetic: NATURAL inputs (SNDlib, repository graphs), MATHEMATICAL truth
